name: Endeavour (STS-47)
about: Endeavour (STS-47) (1992-061A), a crewed vehicle (OV-105), launched 1992 Sep 12. One orbit from GCAT's satcat (shape and inclination; orientation estimated), then how that phase ended (L).

pieces.why: GCAT gives the orbit's shape and inclination, not its orientation or where along it the craft was; the orbit is GCAT's at its epoch (1992 Sep 14), held fixed
GCAT names the site (KSC RW33); its coordinates are written from memory
